description: Creates a Napkin sheet (multi-tab spreadsheet), optionally titled. Then populate it with napkin_sheets_set_cells (headers in row 1). Tell the user where it landed — the Sheets tab in Napkin.

workspace.description: Workspace slug. Personal tokens with no default workspace MUST pass this; tokens with a default can override per call. Ignored for workspace API keys.
